script_text: Whisper the moon is watching you. Meanwhile, the 10th House of career demands you release control to Saturn, forcing a structured transformation in your professional sphere. Your karmic lesson requires facing Chiron in Aries and the South Node retrograde, healing old wounds to align with your North Node. This Full Moon Ritual demands you shed a false self-image to claim your true power. Meditate under the moonlight to anchor the Pisces energy.
